robots_cleaning_summary: This little cleaning robot quietly zooms through the house.
robots_cleaning_description: It vacuums the floor and keeps everything tidy without getting in the way. A handy helper that loves keeping the home clean!
robots_home_service_summary: This tall and clever robot is always ready to help.
robots_home_service_description: It can move around the house, carry things, do simple chores, and help with everyday tasks. A calm and friendly helper for home!
robots_trashcan_summary: This little trashcan robot helps keep the neighborhood clean!
robots_trashcan_description: It rolls around cheerfully and comes over when it sees that you are holding trash. Drop your paper or wrapper inside, and together you help keep the area clean!
robots_delivery_summary: This big delivery robot is a real hero on wheels!
robots_delivery_description: With its sturdy look, cheerful lights, and rounded shapes, it stands out right away. It brings packages safely to homes or meets people outside to hand something over. Just like a package courier on wheels!
robots_instruction: Create a fun, friendly, or funny little sound that lets someone know the robot wants to pass by.
robots_signal_prompt: Imagine the robot wants to pass someone. What sound could the robot make to let them know:
robots_signal_hint: Think of a beep, little melody, or funny sound that catches attention right away, without being scary or loud!
